using System;
using System.Linq;
using System.Net;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Garnet.common.Tests;

public class FormatTests
{
    private const int Port = 8080;
    private readonly Mock<ILogger> _mockLogger;

    public FormatTests()
    {
        _mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TryCreateEndpoint_WhenHostnameDoesNotMatchMachineHostname_LogsError()
    {
        // Arrange
        string testHostname = "nonexistenthost";
        string machineHostname = "myMachine";

        // Act
        var result = Format.TryCreateEndpoint(testHostname, Port, tryConnect: false, _mockLogger.Object);

        // Assert
        Assert.Null(result);
        _mockLogger.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Error,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat>(
                    log => log.ToString().Contains("Provided hostname does not much acquired machine name") &&
                           log.ToString().Contains(testHostname) &&
                           log.ToString().Contains(machineHostname)),
                It.IsAny<Exception>()),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TryCreateEndpoint_WhenNoIPAddressesFound_LogsError()
    {
        // Arrange
        string invalidHostname = "totally.invalid.hostname";

        // Act
        var result = Format.TryCreateEndpoint(invalidHostname, Port, tryConnect: false, _mockLogger.Object);

        // Assert
        Assert.Null(result);
        _mockLogger.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Error,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat>(
                    log => log.ToString().Contains("No IP address found for hostname") &&
                           log.ToString().Contains(invalidHostname)),
                It.IsAny<Exception>()),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TryCreateEndpoint_WhenNoReachableIPFound_LogsError()
    {
        // Arrange
        string unreachableHost = "unreachable.example.com";

        // Act
        var result = Format.TryCreateEndpoint(unreachableHost, Port, tryConnect: true, _mockLogger.Object);

        // Assert
        Assert.Null(result);
        _mockLogger.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Error,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat>(
                    log => log.ToString().Contains("No reachable IP address found for hostname") &&
                           log.ToString().Contains(unreachableHost)),
                It.IsAny<Exception>()),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TryCreateEndpoint_WhenDNSResolutionFails_LogsError()
    {
        // Arrange
        string invalidDnsName = "invalid..dns.name";

        // Act
        var result = Format.TryCreateEndpoint(invalidDnsName, Port, tryConnect: false, _mockLogger.Object);

        // Assert
        Assert.Null(result);
        _mockLogger.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Error,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat>(
                    log => log.ToString().Contains("Error while trying to resolve hostname") &&
                           log.ToString().Contains(invalidDnsName)),
                It.IsAny<Exception>()),
            Times.Once);
    }
}
